title: Yellow Smoky Portuguese Peppers Bake
description: A grassy and springy Portuguese dish featuring yellow peppers, perfect for a crowd, and shojin-friendly. This wood-fired bake is a delightful and flavorful experience.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tops off the yellow peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Stuff each pepper with the onion mixture, filling to the top.
Place the stuffed peppers in the wood-fired oven and bake for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, sprinkle the minced garlic and chopped parsley over the peppers.
Return the peppers to the oven and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the peppers from the oven and squeeze the lemon juice over the top.
Let the peppers cool for a few minutes before serving.
